findings.title: Flag and its value are one argument
findings.cause: container web exits because its args holds "--port 8080" as one item: the program receives the flag and its value as a single argument, space included, and does not know a flag by that name; its log says: "Error: unknown flag: --port 8080"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 2 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Error: unknown flag: --port 8080
Usage: server [--port N] [--root DIR]

evidence.what: container web's args holds "--port 8080" as one item

findings.fix: Write the flag and its value as two items: "--port", "8080" (or one item "--port=8080"). Each item of command and args is passed to the program as one argument, and no shell splits it at spaces.
